meta.label: OCCUPATION LEAD BOARD per branch — MEASURED nearby establishment counts ranked by an ESTIMATED editorial title-loan fit map. For branch managers doing LOCAL CUSTOMER ACQUISITION at an existing branch — NOT a branch-expansion layer.
meta.objective: Acquisition (objective #2, local flavor): which occupations near THIS branch to court first.
meta.index_note: branches[] is INDEX-ALIGNED to platform/data/branches.json (entry i <-> branch i), identical to branch_occupations.json / branch_labor.json / occupation_risk.json.
meta.ranking: lead_score = n (MEASURED catchment establishment count, <=10km) x fit weight (ESTIMATED editorial: high 1.0 / med 0.6 / low 0.25). Top 5 buckets with n>0, sorted score desc, count desc, key asc.
meta.fit_map_provenance: ESTIMATED / EDITORIAL. The high/med/low fit ratings and rationales in buckets[] are product judgements (vehicle-owning likelihood x cash-flow volatility x informal income needing non-bank credit), NOT measured conversion rates. They are embedded in full so the judgement is auditable and can be argued with. Counts (n) are MEASURED; the weighting is not.
meta.risk_flag: rf:1 marks a lead in a STRESSED sector — flagged for careful underwriting, never excluded. Rule (mirrors occupation_risk.json): bucket stress weight >= 0.35, where factory = the national manufacturing-softness lever (0.50, ESTIMATED, occupation_risk.json meta) and agriculture = the branch's OWN province crop-household stress (crop_stress.json agri_stress, ESTIMATED). All other buckets carry no stress weight.
meta.untapped: u[] = ESTIMATED INFERENCE 'presence we are not yet monetizing': buckets whose nearby count is in the network's TOP quartile for that bucket (>= q0.75) while the mapped branch segment score (seg: a=agri, m=merchant, c=collateral) sits in the network's BOTTOM quartile (<= q0.25). Max 3 per branch, count desc. The presence is MEASURED; the 'not monetizing' read is inferred from segment scores, not from loan books.

fields.leads[].k: occupation bucket key (join buckets[] for label/fit weight/why).
fields.leads[].n: MEASURED — establishments of this bucket within <=10km of the branch (Overture Maps Places, a sample/lower bound, not a registry).
fields.leads[].f: ESTIMATED — fit rating initial (h/m/l) from the editorial fit map.
fields.leads[].rf: ESTIMATED — present (1) only when the lead's sector is stressed (see risk_flag).
fields.u[]: ESTIMATED inference — high-presence bucket whose mapped segment score is low (k, n MEASURED count, seg a/m/c, sv the branch's segment score).
fields.inf: MEASURED — province informal-work share %% (NSO, via branch_labor.json); province-inherited; null where absent.
fields.fw: MEASURED — registered factory workers in the branch's district (DIW, via branch_labor.json); null where the district is not measured.

inputs: branch_occupations.json (MEASURED counts — Overture Maps Places, sample/lower bound)
branches.json (segment scores a/m/c + province; MEASURED features, scores are model outputs)
branch_labor.json (MEASURED NSO informal share + DIW factory workers)

buckets.label: Factory / production
buckets.why: Shift/OT wage swings; motorcycle- and pickup-owning workers with thin bank files — the classic title-loan cash-gap borrower.

buckets.label: Auto trade & mechanics
buckets.why: Vehicle-rich trade: garages, dealers and parts shops hold titles and need fast working capital between jobs.

buckets.label: Market vendors & retail
buckets.why: Market vendors and small shops run on informal daily cash and own motorcycles/pickups for stock runs — restocking gaps fit title credit.

buckets.label: Food service
buckets.why: Street food and small eateries: informal daily cash income, motorcycle-owning, largely underbanked.

buckets.label: Hospitality / tourism
buckets.why: Seasonal tourism income swings create cash gaps, but wages are steadier than trade; staff commonly own motorcycles.

buckets.label: Finance & pawn
buckets.why: Banked professionals and competing lenders — their presence signals local credit demand, not leads.

buckets.label: Healthcare
buckets.why: Salaried and bank-served; little need to pledge a vehicle.

buckets.label: Education
buckets.why: Teacher/civil-service pay with savings-cooperative credit access; rarely title-loan customers.

buckets.label: Public sector
buckets.why: Salaried with GSB/co-op access; low non-bank credit need.

buckets.label: Professional & office
buckets.why: Formal payroll and bank credit access; weak title-loan fit.

buckets.label: Agriculture
buckets.why: Pickup- and tractor-owning farmers with harvest-cycle cash gaps and informal income — core title-loan demand.

buckets.label: Personal services
buckets.why: Salons, repair and laundry micro-operators: informal income, motorcycle-owning, modest ticket sizes.

buckets.label: Logistics & transport
buckets.why: Drivers and riders own the truck, van or bike they work with; per-job income is volatile — the vehicle is both livelihood and collateral.

buckets.label: Construction & trades
buckets.why: Pickup-owning contractors with lumpy project cash flow and informal subcontract income.
